dict.string: Fog Map clears the map as you go places. It needs your location while you're using the app to start filling in your map.

Fog Map fills in your personal map even when it's not open, so a walk or a drive gets recorded automatically. Background location is the entire point of the app — without it, your map only updates while you're staring at your phone.
Fog Map uses motion data to tell when you're walking, driving, or stationary, so it can save battery by not tracking GPS when you're not moving.
